scripts.lint: turbo run lint && eslint scripts tests && prettier --check .
scripts.app:down: docker compose --profile app stop db-init api web
scripts.app:reset: docker compose --profile app down -v && docker compose --profile app up -d --build --wait
scripts.db:migrate: turbo run build --filter=@olly/db --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @olly/db run migrate
scripts.db:rollback: turbo run build --filter=@olly/db --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @olly/db run rollback
scripts.db:seed: turbo run build --filter=@olly/db --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @olly/db run seed
